whyItMatters: Concatenating values into SQL text lets input characters become query syntax, so the database runs the attacker's query (SQL injection).
actions: Convert every concatenated query to placeholders with bound values.
Allowlist table and column names — identifiers cannot be bound as values.
Re-run a SAST scan and confirm DPK-SAST-008 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and query text contains no + concatenation.

example.before: db.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = " + id)
example.caveat: Placeholder syntax varies by driver (?, $1, :id) — match this codebase's driver.
